title: impossible to connect the pump correctly
body:
Some users without updating the dev version were using the code from february. 
They get for some of them the expiration notification, for other none and lost the loop.
I have users with Dana RS/I and combo, who can not connect the pump correctly.
For Combo, i revert the commit in april (3 commits were tag specificly for Combo), we get a pairing without difficulties, but the pump stay suspended after the loop refresh. 
For Dana, we can send a bolus and the basal in the profile works but the pump is not connected correctly and loop can not run. 
[AndroidAPS_LOG_1728077261966.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17268760/AndroidAPS_LOG_1728077261966.log.zip)  => combo

[AndroidAPS_LOG_1728204990294.log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/17268763/AndroidAPS_LOG_1728204990294.log.zip) => Dana

I will try to come back month by month to determine which modifications can be responsible of that, but i'm not sure it's a driver problem regarding the fact we have Dana Rs, Dana I and Combo, with the case. 
Any help will be good
